payload.deduplication: Reuse a lemma ID; add separately evidenced senses and new occurrences. Never discard a new meaning.
payload.familyRule: Only include attested forms; distinguish derivation and inflection.
payload.missingValueRule: Use null or an empty list, record why; never invent an original worksheet or source.
payload.sourceRule: Record quote/locator and author role for every extracted item.
payload.publicationRule: Draft/private until explicit content review; source assistant text is not automatically verified.
